summary: This page details the upscale select-service hotel segment attributes and presents a Top-N tenants table for FY2024, listing ARA USH Chicago Tenant, LLC (83.7%), ARA USH Blue Runner Tenant, LLC (13.0%), and ARA CS Tenant, LLC (3.3%) as master lessees with their respective revenue percentages and lease expiry dates. No audited Portfolio Statement, financial statements, or DPU highlights are present on this page.

This page presents the audited Portfolio Statement listing 15 Hyatt portfolio hotels across multiple US states with their respective cities and brand names, valued as at 31 December 2024. The reporting unit is not explicitly stated in the text, but the date format aligns with standard financial reporting conventions for such statements.

This page presents a table detailing property metrics including Number of Rooms, Land Tenure, Year of Last Renovation, Valuation (USD $mil), Revenue (USD $mil), and Occupancy Rate for 17 individual properties. The reporting unit is explicitly stated as USD $mil throughout the data columns.

This page presents a detailed audited Portfolio Statement listing Hyatt, Marriott, and Hilton hotel properties across various US states with their respective locations and brand names. The reporting unit is USD million as indicated by the acquisition cost figures in footnotes (e.g., \$43.0 million).

This page presents a table detailing the audited portfolio statement with property valuations and revenue metrics for 15 properties, listing Number of Rooms, Land Tenure (Freehold/Leasehold), Year of Last Renovation, Valuation in USD $mil, Revenue in USD $mil, and Occupancy Rate. The reporting unit is explicitly stated as USD $mil throughout the table data.

This page presents an operational review and performance snapshot for the SGX REIT, featuring a table with occupancy rate (68.7%), average daily rate (US$140), and revenue per available room (US$96), alongside a "Performance Highlight" section displaying gross revenue of US$168.8 million, gross operating profit of US$59.6 million, and net property income of US$44.3 million. The content further details portfolio optimization activities including asset sales of Hyatt Place Pittsburgh Airport, Hyatt House Philadelphia Plymouth Meeting, and Hyatt House Shelton, along with executed enhancement projects at six hotels.

This page presents the Capital Management section featuring a table of financial highlights including Net Asset Value per Stapled Security (US$0.73), Average Leverage Ratio (41.6%), and Interest Coverage Ratio (1.8x), alongside a valuation note stating a 2.2% year-on-year increase in portfolio valuation to USD 728 million based on 33 hotels.

This page presents the Financial Summary of an SGX REIT, featuring five key tables detailing Revenue (US$ Million), Net Property Income (US$ Million), Gross Operating Profit (US$ Million), Distributable Income (US$ Million), and Distribution per Stapled Security (US Cents) from FY2020 to FY2024. Additionally, it includes a table for Net Asset Value per Stapled Security (US Cents) covering the same period, all reported in US dollars.

This page presents the **Statement of Total Return** for SGX REIT ACRO-HT, displaying five years of financial highlights including Revenue (US$ million), Gross Operating Profit, Net Property Income, Distributable Income, Distribution per Stapled Security (US cents), and Distribution Yield (%). It also includes a **Balance Sheet as at 31 December** with assets, liabilities, and stapled securityholders' funds in US$ million, alongside a **Financial Ratios** table reporting metrics such as Net Asset Value per Stapled Security, Aggregate Leverage, Net Gearing, Interest Coverage Ratio, and debt maturity details.

This page contains biographical information about Mr. Lee Jin Yong, the Chief Executive Officer of the Managers, including his extensive experience in hotel management and investment. No schema-relevant data such as audited Portfolio Statements, financial highlights, or tenant mix tables are present on this page.

This page presents a table detailing U.S. Hotel Investment Volume and Average Deal Size from 2015 to 2024, alongside textual descriptions of ACRO-HT's FY2024 portfolio performance including occupancy, RevPAR, and ADR metrics for Hyatt, Marriott, and Hilton brands.

This page contains the FY2024 Investor Relations Calendar table, detailing scheduled analyst earnings calls and investor conferences for each quarter of 2024. No schema-relevant data such as audited financial statements, tenant mix, or distribution highlights are present on this page.

This page presents the Financial Calendar for SGX REIT covering fiscal years ended 31 December 2024 and 2025, detailing announcement dates for results and distributions alongside FY2024 Annual General Meeting timing. The primary artifact is a table on Stapled Security Price Performance reporting US$ opening/closing/high/low prices, average closing price, total traded volume, average daily volume, and Total Return percentages in USD terms.

This page presents the Relative Performance Indices table and chart for FY2024, detailing the ACRO-HT index alongside the FTSE Straits Times Index and FTSE ST All-Share REIT Index from Jan-2024 to Dec-2024. The reporting unit is not explicitly stated in the text, but the data reflects share price performance with a note that figures are unadjusted for corporate actions.
This page contains only an abstract graphic design featuring the word "Reports" and no schema-relevant data.

This page contains the Independent Auditor's Report for Acrophyte Hospitality Trust (formerly ARA US Hospitality Trust) from Ernst & Young LLP, detailing the auditors' responsibilities regarding accounting policies, going concern assessments, and internal controls. The report concludes with the opinion that records kept by the Trustee-Manager in accordance with the Act have been properly maintained and is dated 27 March 2025.

This page presents the **Statements of Financial Position** for ACRO-REIT Group, ACRO-BT Group, and the Stapled Group as at 31 December 2024, reporting assets, liabilities, and net assets in US$'000. The table details non-current and current asset/liability line items including investment properties, loans, derivatives, and cash equivalents across all three entities, alongside Stapled Securities issued and Net Asset Value per security.

This page presents the Statements of Comprehensive Income for the ACRO-REIT Group, ACRO-BT Group, and Stapled Group for the financial year ended 31 December 2024, reporting revenue, operating expenses, management fees, finance costs, fair-value changes, and tax in US$'000. The table details the net loss/income before and after tax, other comprehensive income items including revaluation gains/losses, and total comprehensive income for each group.

This page presents the **Statement of Distributable Income** for the Stapled Group for the financial year ended 31 December 2024, reporting a net distribution amount to Stapled Securityholders of US$9,254,000 (US$'000) with a Distribution Per Share (DPS) of 1.595 US cents after retention. The table details adjustments including depreciation, manager's fees, and revaluation gains to arrive at the distributable income from a net loss after tax of US$(23,692,000), alongside notes on the group's policy to distribute at least 90% of its distribution income semi-annually.

This page presents the Statements of Movements in Stapled Securityholders' Funds for the ACRO-REIT Group for the year ended 31 December 2024, reporting balances and movements in US$'000. The table details total comprehensive income (net loss), other comprehensive income from fair value changes on cash flow hedges, and contributions via management fees paid/payable in stapled securities.

This page presents the Statements of Movements in Stapled Securityholders' Funds for ACRO-BT Group, reporting figures in US$'000. The table details total income attributable to securityholders, distributions made, management fees paid in securities, and the resulting balances at 1 January 2023 and 31 December 2024 across issue costs and revenue reserve columns.

This page presents the Statements of Movements in Stapled Securityholders' Funds for the financial year ended 31 December 2024, detailing the reconciliation of reserves and total comprehensive income of US$'000. The table explicitly reports a Total loss for the year attributable to Stapled Securityholders of (US$23,692) and a Total other comprehensive income of US$35,532, resulting in a Total comprehensive income for the year of US$11,842.

This page presents the Statements of Movements in Stapled Securityholders' Funds for the year ended 31 December 2023, reporting changes in reserves and total funds measured in US$'000. Key data points include a total loss attributable to securityholders of (11,143) US$'000, other comprehensive income of (3,936) US$'000 driven by fair value changes on hedging instruments and property revaluations, and a net distribution to stapled securityholders of (18,065) US$'000 offset by management fees of 1,043 US$'000.

This page presents the **Cash Flow Statements** for the ACRO-REIT Group, ACRO-BT Group, and Stapled Group for the financial year ended 31 December 2024, reporting figures in US$'000. The table details cash flows from operating activities (including net loss/income before tax, depreciation of property, plant and equipment, and net change in fair value of investment properties) and investing activities (such as acquisition of investment property, proceeds from disposition of assets held for sale, and payment for capital expenditure).

This page presents the Cash Flow Statements for the financial year ended 31 December 2024, detailing cash flows from financing activities including proceeds and repayments of loans, interest paid, distributions to Stapled Securityholders, and net cash movements across the ACRO-REIT Group, ACRO-BT Group, and Stapled Group reported in US$'000. The table concludes with the cash and cash equivalents balances at the beginning and end of the year for each reporting entity.
This page contains no schema-relevant data.

This page contains the summary of material accounting policies for the ACRO-REIT Group, ACRO-BT Group, and Stapled Group for the financial year ended 31 December 2024, specifically detailing derecognition rules, offsetting criteria, cash equivalents, and derivative financial instrument hedge accounting. No schema-relevant data such as audited Portfolio Statements, Total Return tables, or DPU highlights are present on this page.

This page details the ACRO-REIT Group's accounting policies regarding impairment of non-derivative financial assets, including criteria for significant credit risk increase (90 days past due), default definitions, and ECL measurement methods. No schema-relevant data such as audited portfolio statements, total return tables, or tenant mix is present on this page.

This page presents the **Investment Properties** table for the ACRO-REIT Group, reporting fair value changes, capital expenditure, and net movements in US$'000 for the year ended 31 December 2024 alongside a note on pledged security assets. It also includes accounting policy summaries regarding earnings per Stapled Security and segment reporting details.

This page details the fair value measurement of investment properties for SGX REIT's audited Portfolio Statement as of 31 December 2024, categorising them as Level 3 and providing a reconciliation in US$'000 between the carrying amount of right-of-use assets (1,109) and investment properties (688,231). It further presents valuation techniques using discounted cash flows with significant unobservable inputs including discount rates (10.00%-10.50%) and terminal capitalisation rates (7.50%-9.00%), alongside management notes on these assumptions without listing specific tenant or financial highlight tables.

This page presents the Audited Portfolio Statement for Property, Plant and Equipment (carrying amounts in US$'000) for the ACRO-BT Group as of 31 December 2024. The table details land and buildings, motor vehicles, furniture/fixtures/equipment, capital work-in-progress, additions, depreciation, and impairment losses across these asset categories.

This page of the SGX REIT annual report for the year ended 31 December 2024 contains a table titled "PROPERTY, PLANT AND EQUIPMENT" reporting asset values in US$'000. The data details the stapled group's property, plant, and equipment at both valuation and cost across categories including freehold land, buildings, leasehold land, motor vehicles, furniture, fixtures and equipment, and capital work in progress, with movements recorded from 1 January 2023 to 31 December 2024 via additions, reclassifications, revaluation differences recognized in OCI or profit or loss, and elimination of accumulated depreciation.

This page presents the audited Portfolio Statement (property valuations) for Property, Plant and Equipment, detailing asset categories such as freehold land, buildings, leasehold land, motor vehicles, furniture/fixtures/equipment, and capital work in progress with their carrying amounts at cost and accumulated depreciation for the financial year ended 31 December 2024, all reported in US$'000.

This page contains no schema-relevant data, as it presents non-financial notes regarding pledged security, fair value measurement of hotel properties, and intangible asset amortization alongside loans to/from related corporations, without including any audited portfolio statements, total return tables, revenue/expense breakdowns, tenant mix, or distribution highlights.

This page presents the Deferred Tax Assets/(Liabilities) table for the SGX REIT's Stapled Group, detailing tax losses carried forward and property, plant, and equipment items as at 31 December 2024 in US$'000. The reporting unit explicitly names ACRO-BT Group and ACRO-REIT Group within the financial data presented.

This page of the SGX REIT annual report for the year ended 31 December 2024 presents the audited Portfolio Statement for Trade and Other Receivables (in US$'000) and Cash and Cash Equivalents (in US$'000), detailing balances across the ACRO-REIT Group, ACRO-BT Group, and Stapled Group. The notes disclose that trade receivables are leased properties to the ACRO-BT Group under a master lease arrangement, with non-trade amounts due from related corporations representing unsecured, interest-free advances settled in cash.

This page presents a table detailing the assets held for sale (classified as level 3 fair values) for the ACRO-REIT Group, ACRO-BT Group, and Stapled Group, reporting balances in US$'000 for the financial year ended 31 December 2024. The artifact outlines movements including reclassifications from investment properties, net changes in fair value, disposal losses, and completed sales of specific Hyatt hotels such as HHPM, HHS, and HPPA, along with details on the Excess Land valuation and sale.

This page presents the Loans and Borrowings table for the ACRO-REIT Group, ACRO-BT Group, and Stapled Group as of 31 December 2024, reporting non-current and current loan balances in US$'000 across secured bank loans, unsecured bank loans, and lease liabilities. The accompanying notes detail the specific loan facilities comprising a secured term loan and letter of credit, an unsecured term loan, and an unsecured revolving facility, alongside the financial covenants requiring compliance with aggregate leverage limits, networth thresholds, and interest coverage ratios based on EBITDA.

This page presents the terms and debt repayment schedule for loans and borrowings as of 31 December 2024 and 2023, detailing nominal interest rates, maturity years, face values, and carrying amounts in US$'000 for the ACRO-REIT Group, ACRO-BT Group, and Stapled Group. The data outlines specific debt instruments including secured and unsecured bank loans alongside lease liabilities, with a note indicating that unsecured loans maturing in 2025 were refinanced on 28 February 2025.

This page of the SGX REIT annual report for the year ended 31 December 2024 presents a reconciliation table (in US$'000) detailing movements in lease liabilities, bank borrowings, interest payable, and amounts due to related corporations under "Loans and Borrowings." The ACRO-REIT Group's total liabilities decreased by $44,939 through financing cash flows and increased by $49,080 from other liability-related changes, resulting in a year-end balance of $340,343.

This page presents the reconciliation of movements in liabilities to cash flows arising from financing activities for the ACRO-REIT Group, detailing changes in lease liabilities, bank borrowings, interest payable, and amounts due to related corporations between 1 January 2023 and 31 December 2023. The table reports all figures in US$'000 and includes line items such as proceeds from loans, repayment of borrowings, transaction costs, interest paid, and other liability-related adjustments resulting in a total ending balance of US$336,202'000.

This page presents the reconciliation of movements of liabilities to cash flows arising from financing activities for the ACRO-BT Group as of 31 December 2024, reporting figures in US$'000. The table details changes in lease liabilities, bank borrowings, loans from related corporations, interest payable, and amounts due to related corporations, totaling US$57,523'000 at year-end.

This page of the SGX REIT annual report for the year ended 31 December 2024 contains a table titled "Reconciliation of movements of liabilities to cash flows arising from financing activities (continued)" in US$'000, detailing changes in lease liabilities, bank borrowings, loans from related corporations, interest payable, and amounts due to related corporations. The data includes proceeds and repayments from financing cash flows alongside other liability-related adjustments such as interest expense and lease remeasurement, reconciling the opening balance at 1 January 2023 to the closing balance at 31 December 2023.

This page presents the reconciliation of movements in liabilities arising from financing activities for the Stapled Group, detailing lease liabilities, bank borrowings, and interest payable in US$'000 as of 31 December 2024. The table records changes from financing cash flows (such as loan proceeds and repayments) and other liability-related adjustments including interest expense and lease liability recognition to arrive at year-end balances.

This page presents financial data from the Notes to the Financial Statements for the year ended 31 December 2024, specifically detailing derivative financial assets/(liabilities) in US$'000 and trade and other payables across the ACRO-REIT Group, ACRO-BT Group, and Stapled Group. The content includes a table of interest rate swaps categorized by current and non-current positions alongside a comprehensive breakdown of trade payables, amounts due to related corporations (trade and non-trade), related parties, other payables, and interest payable with corresponding comparative figures.

This page of the SGX REIT annual report for the year ended 31 December 2024 presents **NOTES TO THE FINANCIAL STATEMENTS** (Note 15), specifically detailing Stapled Securities in issue and to be issued with values reported in SGD'000 across the ACRO-REIT Group, ACRO-BT Group, and Stapled Group. The table records management fees paid or payable in Stapled Securities, noting that no such securities were issued in 2024 but providing historical data from 2023 alongside unit issuance details and capital management policies.

This page presents the Net Asset Value per Stapled Security table (US$'000) and a detailed Revenue statement for ACRO-REIT Group, ACRO-BT Group, and the Stapled Group covering 2024 and 2023. The revenue data includes room revenue, other operating revenue, and rental income of US$54,580 (2024) and US$55,203 (2023) for ACRO-REIT, with notes explaining that rental revenue relates to receivables from the ACRO-BT Group under master lease agreements involving fixed and variable components adjusted for CPI.

This page presents the Notes to the Financial Statements for the year ended 31 December 2024, specifically detailing Other Income and Net Finance (Costs)/Income in US$'000 across ACRO-REIT Group, ACRO-BT Group, and Stapled Group. It includes a table of finance income and costs comprising interest on deposits, loans from related corporations, lease liabilities, and amortisation of transaction costs, along with notes on management fees satisfied by issuing Stapled Securities.

This page presents the "Net (loss)/income for the year before tax" table detailing operating expenses, auditor's remuneration, and expected credit loss allowances for the ACRO-REIT Group, ACRO-BT Group, and Stapled Group for the financial year ended 31 December 2024, with all figures reported in US$'000.

This page presents the Taxation notes for the ACRO-REIT Group, ACRO-BT Group, and Stapled Group for the financial year ended 31 December 2024, reporting tax recognised in profit or loss and other comprehensive income in US$'000. The content includes a reconciliation of the effective tax rate detailing current and deferred tax expenses, adjustments for foreign jurisdictions, tax-exempt income, and non-deductible expenses across all three entities.

This page presents the reconciliation of effective tax rate and a table detailing Earnings per Stapled Security (EPS) for the financial year ended 31 December 2024, reporting US$'000 and '000 units respectively. The content includes net loss attributable to Stapled Securityholders, weighted average issued Stapled Securities, and basic/diluted EPS figures in US cents, with no audited portfolio statement, total return, or tenant mix tables present.

This page presents the **Operating Segments** table detailing performance by reportable segments (Hyatt, Marriott, Hilton) in US$'000 for the year ended 31 December 2024. It includes revenue, segment net property income, depreciation, amortisation, revaluation, and unallocated items such as management fees, trustee fees, finance costs, taxation, and the resulting net loss of $(23,692).

This page presents the Operating Segments for the financial year ended 31 December 2024, featuring a detailed table of reportable segment net property income and other segmental information in US$'000 for Hyatt, Marriott, Hilton, and the Total. The data includes reconciliations of reportable segment assets and liabilities alongside unallocated items such as management fees, trustee expenses, finance costs, and taxation, with a note confirming operations are limited to the United States.

This page presents the Financial Risk Management note detailing the ACRO-REIT Group's exposure to credit, liquidity, and market risks within its risk management framework. The main artifact is a table reporting impairment losses on financial assets for 2024 and 2023 in US$'000, showing an allowance of $58,000 for the ACRO-REIT Group and Stapled Group respectively, while the ACRO-BT Group reported $58,000 for 2024 and $8,000 for 2023.

This page presents a table detailing the exposure to credit risk and Expected Credit Loss (ECL) allowances for trade receivables of the ACRO-REIT Group and ACRO-BT Group as at 31 December 2024 and 2023, with amounts reported in US$'000. The data shows gross carrying amounts ranging from $232,000 to $2,469,000, alongside corresponding ECL allowances of $(32,000) and $(22,000), respectively.

This page presents the Expected credit loss assessment and movements in allowance for impairment regarding trade receivables for the ACRO-REIT Group, ACRO-BT Group, and Stapled Group for the financial year ended 31 December 2024. The data is explicitly reported in US$'000 and details gross carrying amounts, credit-impaired classifications, and allowance changes across three aging buckets (not past due through over 90 days) for both 2024 and 2023.

This page contains the ACRO-REIT Group's Liquidity Risk exposure table detailing remaining contractual maturities of financial liabilities at the reporting date for 2024 and 2023, presented in US$'000. The artifact lists non-derivative and derivative financial liabilities (including loans from related corporations, loans and borrowings, trade payables, and interest rate swaps) categorized by cash flow timing within 1 year, between 1 to 5 years, and more than 5 years.

This page presents a liquidity risk table detailing the carrying amounts and contractual cash flows (categorized by time buckets) of non-derivative financial liabilities for the ACRO-BT Group and Stapled Group as of 31 December 2024, with values reported in US$'000. The data covers loans from related corporations, loans and borrowings, and trade and other payables for both 2024 and 2023, including specific breakdowns within each group.

This page presents the ACRO-REIT Group's financial risk management disclosures for the year ended 31 December 2024, specifically detailing interest rate risk and market exposure. The main artifact is a table titled "Exposure to interest rate risk," which reports nominal amounts of fixed-rate financial assets and liabilities for the ACRO-REIT Group, ACRO-BT Group, and Stapled Group in US$'000.

This page presents the ACRO-REIT Group's financial risk management disclosures for the year ended 31 December 2024, specifically detailing exposure to interest rate risk and fair value sensitivity analyses reported in US$'000. It includes tables showing nominal amounts of variable rate financial liabilities and hedging instruments, alongside cash flow sensitivity analysis quantifying the potential impact on profit or loss and Stapled Securityholders' funds from a 100 basis point shift in interest rates.

This page presents the Cash flow sensitivity analysis for variable rate instruments and a table of Interest rate swaps within the Market risk disclosure section, reporting figures in US$'000 for the ACRO-BT Group, Stapled Group, and combined ACRO-REIT Group and Stapled Group.

This page presents the **Accounting classifications and fair values** table detailing the carrying amounts and fair values of financial assets and liabilities for the ACRO-REIT Group as of 31 December 2024, with all figures reported in US$'000. The table categorizes items such as derivative financial assets, loans to related corporations, trade receivables, cash equivalents, and various liabilities by their accounting classification (e.g., financial assets at amortised cost) and assigns them to Level 1, Level 2, or Level 3 within the fair value hierarchy.

This page presents a table detailing the accounting classifications and fair values of financial assets and liabilities for the ACRO-REIT Group as of 31 December 2023, reporting amounts in US$'000. The artifact lists specific items including derivative financial assets, loans to related corporations, trade receivables, cash equivalents, and various liabilities such as borrowings and payables, categorized by measurement basis (amortised cost or fair value) and fair value hierarchy levels (Level 1, Level 2, and Level 3).

This page presents a table detailing the accounting classifications and fair values of financial assets and liabilities for ACRO-BT Group as of 31 December 2024, reporting amounts in US$'000. The table lists items such as loans to related corporations, trade receivables, cash equivalents, and various payables with their carrying amounts and fair value measurements across Level 1, Level 2, and Level 3 hierarchies.

This page of the SGX REIT annual report presents a table detailing accounting classifications and fair values for ACRO-BT Group's financial assets at amortised cost and other financial liabilities as of 31 December 2023, with figures reported in US$'000. The data includes carrying amounts and fair value levels (Level 1, Level 2, Level 3) for items such as loans to related corporations, trade receivables, cash equivalents, and various payables.

This page presents a table detailing the accounting classifications and fair values of financial assets and liabilities for the Stapled Group as of 31 December 2024, with amounts reported in US$'000. The data covers financial derivative assets, trade receivables, cash equivalents, loans and borrowings, and other payables, categorized by measurement level (Level 1, Level 2, Level 3) and total carrying amounts.

This page presents a table detailing the accounting classifications and fair values of financial assets and liabilities for the Stapled Group as of 31 December 2023, with amounts reported in US$'000. The table categorizes items such as financial derivative assets/liabilities, trade receivables, cash equivalents, loans, and payables by their carrying amount and fair value levels (Level 1, 2, and 3), excluding lease liabilities from borrowings.
This page contains the "Financial instruments measured at fair value" table for ACRO-REIT Group, ACRO-BT Group and Stapled Group under Market Risk notes.

This page presents a Right-of-use assets table for the ACRO-BT Group and Stapled Group, detailing land and buildings, motor vehicles, and leasehold land balances in US$'000 for the financial years ended 31 December 2024 and 2023. Additionally, it includes a partial Profit or Loss section showing interest on lease liabilities and expenses relating to variable and short-term leases for the same periods and groups.

This page presents lease-related disclosures from the SGX REIT annual report for the financial year ended 31 December 2024, specifically detailing cash outflows for leases as a lessee by group (ACRO-REIT Group, ACRO-BT Group, and Stapled Group) in US$'000. It also includes notes on extension options held by the ACRO-REIT Group and Stapled Group, an explanation of operating leases where rental income was US$54,580,000, and a maturity analysis of undiscounted lease payments receivable within one year (US$1,700,000) and between one and five years (US$3,428,000).

This page contains the **Commitments** and **Related Party Transactions** notes for the SGX REIT annual report, presenting capital expenditure contracted but not provided for alongside significant fees (management, trustee, hotel) and intercompany rental/interest flows between ACRO-REIT Group, ACRO-BT Group, and the Stapled Group. All financial figures are reported in US$'000 for the year ended 31 December 2024.

This page presents the Notes to the Financial Statements for the year ended 31 December 2024, featuring a table of significant subsidiaries with their country of incorporation and effective equity interest held by the Group (reported as percentages) under sections covering revaluation and hedging reserves, standards issued but not yet effective.

This page contains the Notes to the Financial Statements for SGX REIT covering the year ended 31 December 2024, specifically detailing a subsequent distribution approved on 27 February 2025 and the authorization of financial statements by the Manager, Trustee-Manager, and Trustee on 27 March 2025.

This page presents the Statistics of Stapled Security Holdings for ACRO-REIT and ACRO-BT as at 19 March 2025, featuring a Distribution of Stapled Security Holdings table and a Top-N tenants/customers table listing the twenty largest holders. The data confirms that 3,324 shareholders held a total of 580,102,394 stapled securities, with Citibank Nominees Singapore Pte Ltd holding the largest stake of 153,636,840 units (26.48%).

This page presents the Statistics of Stapled Security Holdings as at 19 March 2025, featuring a table of Substantial Stapled Securityholders' interests listing Acrophyte Limited and related entities with direct or deemed stakes totaling SGD'000 in securities, alongside a Public Float disclosure confirming approximately 56% public holding.

Ltd., ARA US Hospitality Management, Inc., and others under the ESR Group. The data details transaction amounts excluding those under S$100,000 or conducted under shareholders' mandate pursuant to Rule 920, with a total reported value of 3,096 US$'000 for non-mandate transactions.

This page presents a table of Interested Person Transactions (IPRs) for ACRO-REIT, reporting aggregate values in US$'000 for the financial year ended 31 December 2024.
